title: Independently calibrate recovery outside the finite Polygraphia row-schedule family
statement: In a frozen finite family of periodic row schedules, a ciphertext-only row assignment search identifies all 24 clean/noisy schedule instances over 12 independently remapped keys and three new Latin works. Mean exact recovery on the final 3,000 letters is 98.88% clean and 92.32% after 2% codeword character substitution. The joint 90% recovery and correct schedule gate is met in 12/12 clean and 10/12 noisy instances. A supplemental test preserving authentic column maps, with sampled row blocks and planted schedules, gives 98.51% and 91.72%, and meets the joint gate in 6/6 and 5/6. All three IID controls recover the schedule but average 26.09% exact characters. All three Markov controls generated from the fitting prior meet the joint gate and average 99.60%, so the criterion measures recovery and cannot identify meaningful plaintext. With geometric stays outside the finite family, three Latin cases average 2.39% exact characters. All 45 planted-key counterfactual packets round-trip the exact normalized plaintext and received ciphertext.
check: Implement and review a declarative evaluator before applying this family to manuscript data. Freeze additional disjoint word inventories and independent development controls for schedules with correctly modeled repeats, jumps or gaps. Compare unknown and fixed row schedules with fixed budgets and real decoding coverage as well as true letter accuracy, including unseen codewords and higher-order language controls. Charge explicit cipher table, row sequence and escaped items for candidate readings. Verify that arbitrary tables and adequate first-order controls cannot pass any separate reading criterion.
method: Use three mutually word-disjoint 16-row pools from the same 131-row historical transcription, one for synthetic controls and two for evaluated Latin cases. Plant distinct row-wise random bijections for each key; pair the clean and noisy views. Draw 8 or 16 actual rows and fix the family library to widths 8/12/16 and cyclic or periodic step of two after each 17 or 41 positions. In the primary test the planted periodic nonzero interval is 17. Fit on 7,000 ciphertext words, select on the next 2,000, and evaluate on the final 3,000. Schedule selection charges the fitted literal row catalogs and five-bit known IDs or escaped literals in the validation window. For each fitted row retain up to 24 frequent spellings and use the frozen external Latin bigram prior to optimize a bijection by exact assignment between each row’s spellings and letters with other rows fixed. Use three starts and five sweeps; choose the best validation loss. For unseen spellings the only correction is a unique same-length distance-one match, otherwise the output is unknown. Same-phase shuffles keep unknown positions fixed. IID and Markov control plaintexts come from the external prior; out-of-family geometric stays are unannounced to the schedule selector.
packet_method: For cost disclosure only, the planted-key oracle sends the explicit 24-letter alphabet, full literal lexicon in ordered rows, per-row factoradic permutation rank, periodic family index or exact stay flags, normalized plaintext as fixed five-bit IDs, position-indexed literal exceptions, header and byte alignment. An independent field reader with lengths read from the packet verifies the row positions, full assigned table, normalized letters and every received codeword. The separate ideal bigram bits are an estimate, outside the actual packet. The actual packet costs range from 70,304 to 185,264 bits.
limits: All historical lexical pools are subsets of one edition rather than new manuscript witnesses. The supplemental test preserves the table’s column labels and uses newly sampled row orders and known planted schedule conditions. Runs share source works, so view multiplicities are not independent author counts. Noise is synthetic, preserves codeword length, and assumes token boundaries are known. The stay baseline with true row indices uses frequency ranking only. The known-key packet is an accounting control; its construction receives the planted values and it is not the size of a recovered reading. The schedule library was fixed locally before running the tests. No private or public Voynich hypotheses were evaluated.

corpus.normalization: Lowercase, expand ae and oe ligatures, apply NFKD, remove every character outside a–z. Preserve j and v. Write UTF-8 with no trailing newline.
corpus.reproduction: Acquire the exact raw witnesses at the recorded URLs under raw/, verify their SHA-256 digests, and run python3 extract-sources.py.

frozen_plan.plaintext: New author-disjoint Latin works, first 12000 normalized model-alphabet letters after an explicitly delimited textual incipit. Test truth stays in evaluation.
frozen_plan.planted_challenges: For each independent work and challenge pool use 8 (A) or 16 (B) rows and two schedule types, ordinary cyclic and advance two every 17 tokens. Independently permute all row maps for each key. Keys are reused only between paired clean/noisy views.
frozen_plan.unseen_spelling: Reserve a uniform literal/unknown event for schedule selection; at decoding use no imputation unless unique Hamming-distance-one match in the selected row. All-way unresolved tokens are unknown.
frozen_plan.noise: Independent raw character replacement at 2%, preserving codeword length, using clean historical row-pool glyph inventory.
frozen_plan.unknown_key: Determine row family by portable lexicon plus validation symbol cost, fit one-to-one letter maps by row coordinate assignments with a frozen external Latin bigram prior. Use frequency ranks and two perturbations as starts, five sweeps per start, select by validation likelihood without plaintext.
frozen_plan.negative_controls: Use IID and first-order Markov plaintext from the same external fit prior, also same-phase evaluation shuffles. Use out-of-family geometric stays at 1/8 as a schedule stress control.
frozen_plan.primary: Held-apart exact plaintext character accuracy, lexicon coverage, and stable row-family identification. A high-confidence joint calibration case requires at least .90 held-apart accuracy and an identified family.
frozen_plan.oracle: Separate known-schedule vs full table and schedule baselines; no truth supplied to the learner.
frozen_plan.storage: Bill raw full ordered codeword dictionary and independently indexed row permutations plus finite schedule header and row origin. Include exact literal escapes for noisy words and identify uncharged quantities. Report without applying to Voynich pages.

reproduction.workflow: Extract the two literal scripts below. Obtain the original reference files via the project pins. Download the four original Latin source files as in source manifest and verify their digests. Run extract-sources.py per source manifest; then run PYTHONPATH=. python3 calibrate.py data/raw /path/to/table.csv /path/to/source-texts from the project root.

scripts.calibrate.py:
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import csv
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from math import ceil, factorial, log2
from pathlib import Path
import random
from statistics import mean

from vs.refcorpus import normalize, strip_gutenberg

FIT, SELECT, TEST = 7000, 2000, 3000
N = FIT + SELECT + TEST
A = 24
UNKNOWN = -1
POOLS = {'development': (12,28), 'challenge_a': (47,63), 'challenge_b': (107,123)}
FAMILY = tuple((r,k) for r in (8,12,16) for k in (0,17,41))
TABLE_HASH = 'fe3f24a46dbc6b655eab8dbbd75addf84ee4a7dbd387ad802af75d02edfe5b4d'
REFERENCES = ('pg33849.txt','pg38708.txt','pg16561.txt','pg826.txt')

def positions(n, rows, skip):
    return [(i+(i//skip if skip else 0))%rows for i in range(n)]

def alphabet_ids(raw, alphabet):
    identity={c:i for i,c in enumerate(alphabet)}
    return [identity[c] for c in normalize(raw,'latin') if c in identity]

def latin_model(path, alphabet):
    counts=Counter()
    edges=Counter()
    for name in REFERENCES:
        encoding='latin-1' if name in ('pg16561.txt','pg826.txt') else 'utf-8'
        ys=alphabet_ids(strip_gutenberg((path/name).read_text(encoding=encoding)),alphabet)
        counts.update(ys)
        edges.update(zip(ys,ys[1:]))
    unigram=[(counts[i]+1)/(counts.total()+A) for i in range(A)]
    mass=[]
    for i in range(A):
        row=[edges[i,j]+1 for j in range(A)]
        mass.append([q/sum(row) for q in row])
    return unigram,mass,[[log2(q) for q in row] for row in mass]

def lexicon_bits(forms):
    # One-byte length and then literal ASCII bytes per word. Two-byte
    # row count and per-row dictionary size are counted separately.
    return sum(8*(1+len(w.encode('ascii'))) for w in forms)

def catalog(words, es, r):
    freq=[Counter() for _ in range(r)]
    for w,p in zip(words[:FIT],es[:FIT]):
        freq[p][w]+=1
    forms=[sorted(c,key=lambda w:(-c[w],w))[:A] for c in freq]
    return forms

def select_window(words):
    trials=[]
    for rows,skip in FAMILY:
        es=positions(len(words),rows,skip)
        forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
        look=[set(row) for row in forms]
        dictionary=sum(lexicon_bits(r) for r in forms)+16*(len(forms)+1)
        hit=0
        payload=0
        for w,p in zip(words[FIT:FIT+SELECT],es[FIT:FIT+SELECT]):
            payload+=5 # IDs 0..23 plus one escape
            if w in look[p]:
                hit+=1
            else:
                payload+=lexicon_bits([w])
        score=dictionary+payload
        trials.append((score,rows,skip,hit))
    return min(trials),sorted(trials)

def hungarian(scores):
    """Maximize a square assignment with potentials and shortest augmenting paths."""
    n=len(scores)
    row_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    col_potential=[0.]*(n+1)
    matched_row=[0]*(n+1)
    back=[0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        matched_row[0]=i
        col=0
        dist=[float('inf')]*(n+1)
        used=[False]*(n+1)
        while True:
            used[col]=True
            row=matched_row[col]
            delta=float('inf')
            next_col=0
            for j in range(1,n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    continue
                reduced=-scores[row-1][j-1]-row_potential[row]-col_potential[j]
                if reduced<dist[j]:
                    dist[j]=reduced
                    back[j]=col
                if dist[j]<delta:
                    delta=dist[j]
                    next_col=j
            for j in range(n+1):
                if used[j]:
                    row_potential[matched_row[j]]+=delta
                    col_potential[j]-=delta
                else:
                    dist[j]-=delta
            col=next_col
            if matched_row[col]==0:
                break
        while col:
            prior=back[col]
            matched_row[col]=matched_row[prior]
            col=prior
    out=[0]*n
    for col in range(1,n+1):
        out[matched_row[col]-1]=col-1
    return out

def compile_ids(words, es, forms):
    lookup=[{w:r*A+j for j,w in enumerate(row)} for r,row in enumerate(forms)]
    encoded=[lookup[p].get(w,UNKNOWN) for p,w in zip(es,words)]
    for i in range(FIT,len(words)):
        if encoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            continue
        w=words[i]
        lexicon=lookup[es[i]]
        similar=[id_ for q,id_ in lexicon.items()
                 if len(w)==len(q) and sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(w,q))==1]
        if len(similar)==1:
            encoded[i]=similar[0]
    return encoded

def cost(ids, model):
    return -sum(model[a][b] if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN else -log2(A)
                for a,b in zip(ids,ids[1:]))

def fit_maps(words, es, rows, unigram, log_model, seed, optimize=True):
    forms=catalog(words,es,rows)
    encoded=compile_ids(words,es,forms)
    links=Counter((a,b) for a,b in zip(encoded[:FIT-1],encoded[1:FIT])
                  if a!=UNKNOWN and b!=UNKNOWN)
    assert not optimize or all(a//A!=b//A for a,b in links)
    left=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    right=[[] for _ in range(rows*A)]
    for (a,b),n in links.items():
        left[b].append((a,n))
        right[a].append((b,n))
    reference=sorted(range(A),key=lambda i:(-unigram[i],i))
    initial=reference*rows
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    best=None
    for start in range(3 if optimize else 1):
        mapping=initial[:]
        if start:
            for row in range(rows):
                for _ in range(start+1):
                    a,b=rng.sample(range(row*A,(row+1)*A),2)
                    mapping[a],mapping[b]=mapping[b],mapping[a]
        previous=None
        for sweep in range(5 if optimize else 0):
            for row in range(rows):
                scores=[]
                for active in range(row*A,(row+1)*A):
                    backwards=[(log_model[mapping[i]],n) for i,n in left[active]]
                    forwards=[(mapping[i],n) for i,n in right[active]]
                    scores.append([sum(f[l]*n for f,n in backwards)+
                                   sum(log_model[l][f]*n for f,n in forwards) for l in range(A)])
                mapping[row*A:(row+1)*A]=hungarian(scores)
            objective=sum(log_model[mapping[a]][mapping[b]]*n for (a,b),n in links.items())
            if previous is not None:
                assert objective+1e-7>=previous
            previous=objective
        pred=[mapping[q] if q!=UNKNOWN else UNKNOWN for q in encoded]
        validation=cost(pred[FIT:FIT+SELECT],log_model)
        if best is None or validation<best[0]:
            best=validation,pred,mapping,start
    return best,forms,encoded

def noise(words, alphabet, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    choices={c:[x for x in alphabet if x!=c] for c in alphabet}
    return [''.join(rng.choice(choices[c]) if rng.random()<.02 else c for c in w) for w in words]

def sampled_plain(typ, unigram, mass, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    if typ=='iid':
        return rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=N)
    value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=unigram,k=1)[0]
    out=[value]
    for _ in range(N-1):
        value=rng.choices(range(A),weights=mass[value],k=1)[0]
        out.append(value)
    return out

def same_phase_p(decoded, es, model, seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    bins=defaultdict(list)
    for i,e in enumerate(es):
        if decoded[i]!=UNKNOWN:
            bins[e].append(i)
    observed=cost(decoded,model)
    shorter=0
    for _ in range(39):
        shuffled=decoded[:]
        for values in bins.values():
            vals=[decoded[i] for i in values]
            rng.shuffle(vals)
            for i,val in zip(values,vals):
                shuffled[i]=val
        shorter+=cost(shuffled,model)<=observed
    return (1+shorter)/40

def count_exact(pred, truth):
    return sum(a==b for a,b in zip(pred,truth))/len(truth)

def rank_permutation(table):
    left=sorted(table)
    rank=0
    for entry in table:
        j=left.index(entry)
        rank+=j*factorial(len(left)-1)
        left.pop(j)
    return rank

def unrank_permutation(words, rank):
    left=words[:]
    table=[]
    while left:
        j,rank=divmod(rank,factorial(len(left)-1))
        table.append(left.pop(j))
    return table

def message_costs(tables, words, es, truth, alphabet, model, rows, skip, variant):
    parts=[]
    sizes={}
    def write(value, width, field):
        bits=format(value,f'0{width}b')
        assert len(bits)==width
        parts.append(bits)
        sizes[field]=sizes.get(field,0)+width
    def text_word(word, field):
        write(len(word),8,field)
        for c in word.encode('ascii'):
            write(c,8,field)

    text_word(''.join(alphabet),'alphabet_bits')
    write(len(truth),16,'schedule_bits')
    write(rows,16,'dictionary_bits')
    write(variant=='stays',1,'schedule_bits')
    periodic_width=ceil(log2(len(FAMILY)))
    if variant=='periodic':
        write(FAMILY.index((rows,skip)),periodic_width,'schedule_bits')
    else:
        for a,b in zip(es,es[1:]):
            write(a!=b,1,'schedule_bits')
    perm_width=(factorial(A)-1).bit_length()
    for table in tables:
        write(len(table),16,'dictionary_bits')
        for word in sorted(table):
            text_word(word,'dictionary_bits')
        write(rank_permutation(table),perm_width,'row_permutation_bits')
    for identity in truth:
        write(identity,5,'fixed_plain_payload_bits')
    literals=[(i,w) for i,(w,p,c) in enumerate(zip(words,es,truth)) if w!=tables[p][c]]
    count_width=len(truth).bit_length()
    index_width=(len(truth)-1).bit_length()
    write(len(literals),count_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    for i,w in literals:
        write(i,index_width,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
        text_word(w,'exact_noise_literal_bits')
    stream=''.join(parts)
    pad=(-len(stream))%8
    # The stream length is inferred by reading the final literal count.
    padded=stream+'0'*pad
    packet=int(padded,2).to_bytes(len(padded)//8,'big')
    raw=bin(int.from_bytes(packet,'big'))[2:].zfill(8*len(packet))
    offset=0
    def read(width):
        nonlocal offset
        value=int(raw[offset:offset+width],2)
        offset+=width
        return value
    def read_word():
        return bytes(read(8) for _ in range(read(8))).decode('ascii')
    assert list(read_word())==alphabet
    n=read(16)
    r=read(16)
    if read(1):
        recovered_positions=[0]
        for _ in range(n-1):
            recovered_positions.append((recovered_positions[-1]+read(1))%r)
    else:
        inferred_r,inferred_skip=FAMILY[read(periodic_width)]
        assert inferred_r==r
        recovered_positions=positions(n,r,inferred_skip)
    recovered_tables=[]
    for _ in range(r):
        entries=[read_word() for _ in range(read(16))]
        recovered_tables.append(unrank_permutation(entries,read(perm_width)))
    recovered_truth=[read(5) for _ in range(n)]
    recovered_words=[recovered_tables[e][c] for e,c in zip(recovered_positions,recovered_truth)]
    for _ in range(read(n.bit_length())):
        i=read((n-1).bit_length())
        recovered_words[i]=read_word()
    assert recovered_positions==es and recovered_truth==truth and recovered_words==words
    assert recovered_tables==tables and offset==len(stream) and raw[offset:]=='0'*pad
    return dict(**sizes,padding_bits=pad,packet_bits=8*len(packet),
        model_plain_ideal_bits=cost(truth,model)+log2(A),literals=len(literals),verified_roundtrip=True)

def trial(name, clear, typ, pool, source, rows, skip, schedule, seed, alphabet, unigram, mass, model,
          noise_modes, remapped=True):
    writer=random.Random(seed)
    row_indices=writer.sample(range(len(source)),rows)
    true_table=[]
    for i in row_indices:
        words=list(source[i])
        if remapped:
            writer.shuffle(words)
        true_table.append(words)
    es=positions(N,rows,skip)
    if schedule=='stays':
        es=[0]
        for _ in range(N-1):
            es.append((es[-1]+(writer.random()>=.125))%rows)
    gold=clear if typ=='latin' else sampled_plain(typ,unigram,mass,seed+71901)
    cipher=[true_table[i][c] for i,c in zip(es,gold)]
    characters=sorted({c for row in true_table for w in row for c in w})
    assert [true_table[p].index(w) for p,w in zip(es,cipher)]==gold
    test_gold=gold[FIT+SELECT:]
    result=[]
    for is_noisy in noise_modes:
        observed=noise(cipher,characters,seed+81921) if is_noisy else cipher
        winner, trials=select_window(observed)
        _,r,k,val_hit=winner
        phase=positions(N,r,k)
        (vl,pred,key,start), forms, ids=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221)
        (oracle_loss, known_pred,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,es,rows,unigram,model,seed+221,
                                                   optimize=schedule=='periodic')
        (freq_loss,frequency,*_), _, _=fit_maps(observed,phase,r,unigram,model,seed+221,optimize=False)
        true_exact=[true_table[e].index(w) if w in true_table[e] else UNKNOWN
                    for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],es[FIT+SELECT:])]
        known_catalog=[set(row) for row in forms]
        exact=mean(w in known_catalog[e] for w,e in zip(observed[FIT+SELECT:],phase[FIT+SELECT:]))
        dec=pred[FIT+SELECT:]
        result.append(dict(work=name,kind=typ,pool=pool,rows=rows,skip=skip,schedule=schedule,seed=seed,
            remapped=remapped,
            historical_source_rows=[i+1+POOLS[pool][0] for i in row_indices],noisy=is_noisy,
            selected_rows=r,selected_skip=k,selected_family_correct=(schedule=='periodic' and (r,k)==(rows,skip)),
            candidate_validation_costs=trials,selected_validation_exact_coverage=val_hit/SELECT,
            held_apart_exact_catalog_coverage=exact,held_apart_decode_coverage=mean(q!=UNKNOWN for q in dec),
            selected_start=start,validation_fit_bits=vl,
            accuracy=count_exact(dec,test_gold),frequency_accuracy=count_exact(frequency[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_accuracy=count_exact(known_pred[FIT+SELECT:],test_gold),
            known_schedule_optimizer=('assignment' if schedule=='periodic' else 'frequency'),
            full_table_exact_accuracy=count_exact(true_exact,test_gold),
            same_phase_p=same_phase_p(dec,phase[FIT+SELECT:],model,seed+156987),
            packet=message_costs(true_table,observed,es,gold,alphabet,model,rows,skip,schedule)))
    return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('references',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('table',type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('works',type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    table_bytes=args.table.read_bytes()
    assert sha256(table_bytes).hexdigest()==TABLE_HASH
    full=list(csv.reader(table_bytes.decode().splitlines(),skipinitialspace=True))
    alphabet=full[0]
    assert len(alphabet)==A and len(set(alphabet))==A
    rows=[r for r in full[1:] if len(r)==A]
    pools={p:rows[a:b] for p,(a,b) in POOLS.items()}
    sets={p:{w for r in data for w in r} for p,data in pools.items()}
    assert all(len(v)==16*A for v in sets.values()) and len(set.union(*sets.values()))==len(sets)*16*A
    ug,m,model=latin_model(args.references,alphabet)
    cases=[]
    hashes={}
    for i,work in enumerate(sorted(args.works.glob('*.txt'))):
        hashes[work.name]=sha256(work.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        data=alphabet_ids(work.read_text(),alphabet)
        assert len(data)>=N
        data=data[:N]
        work_seed=760587+10991*i
        for j,(p,r) in enumerate((('challenge_a',8),('challenge_b',16))):
            for l,k in enumerate((0,17)):
                cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,k,'periodic',
                                   work_seed+1100*j+23*l,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True)))
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin',p,pools[p],r,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+40000+1100*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,True),remapped=False))
        for j,kind in enumerate(('iid','markov')):
            cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,kind,'development',pools['development'],8,17,'periodic',
                               work_seed+3200+29*j,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
        cases.extend(trial(work.stem,data,'latin','challenge_a',pools['challenge_a'],8,0,'stays',
                           work_seed+5099,alphabet,ug,m,model,(False,)))
    assert len(hashes)>=2
    results=dict(alphabet=alphabet,source_hashes=hashes,case_count=len(cases),
                 references={f:sha256((args.references/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in REFERENCES},
                 cases=cases)
    print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

reproduction.assignment_smoke_test: All 315 seeded random matrices of size 1 to 7 matched exhaustive optimum; all nine finite candidate schedules passed a no-same-phase adjacency check.
